title: Mushroom sauce for steak - with cream
method: Fry the steaks as normal in a pan. Remove and set aside
Add the mushrooms and thyme leaves to the pan, then cook for a couple of mins until softened and golden.
Stir in the double cream and mustard
Serve the steaks with the mushroom sauce poured over.
